## Add a --write-mixin option to generate mixin tags for model auto-completion

The goal is to introduce a new command-line option, `--write-mixin` (with short alias `-M`), for the `ide-helper:models` command. This option provides a third strategy for model auto-completion documentation:

    - Currently, users can either write the full PHPDoc blocks directly into each model file (`--write`), or generate a separate `_ide_helper_models.php` file containing the documentation.
    - The new option combines both approaches: it writes the full documentation to the `_ide_helper_models.php` file (as with the default behavior), but also adds a simple `@mixin` tag to each model's docblock that points to a prefixed class name in the helper file (e.g., `@mixin IdeHelperPost`).
    - This avoids polluting model files with large docblocks while eliminating the "duplicate class" IDE warnings that occur when the helper file declares classes with the same fully-qualified names as the real models.

    Key behaviors to implement:
    - When `--write-mixin` is used, the helper file should still be generated with the full documentation.
    - Each processed model file should have its existing docblock preserved, with an `@mixin` tag pointing to a class named `IdeHelper{OriginalClassName}` appended.
    - Any existing `@mixin` tags pointing to `IdeHelper*` classes should be removed/replaced to avoid duplication.
    - The generated helper file should use the prefixed class names (e.g., `IdeHelperPost`) instead of the original model class names.
    - The `--write-mixin` option should be documented in the README.
    - Tests should cover this new behavior, including snapshot assertions.

    Please ensure the implementation carefully handles edge cases such as:
    - Models without existing docblocks (the `@mixin` tag should still be added).
    - Preserving all existing tags/comments in the model's docblock while only adjusting the mixin-related part.
    - Properly handling models with the same class name in different namespaces (the prefixed version should still work).

- Check `composer.json` for dependency installation and autoloading configuration.

749:         }
750: 
751:         if (!$phpdoc->getText()) {
752:             $phpdoc->setText($class);
753:         }
754: 
755:         $properties = [];
756:         $methods = [];
757:         foreach ($phpdoc->getTags() as $tag) {
758:             $name = $tag->getName();
759:             if ($name == 'property' || $name == 'property-read' || $name == 'property-write') {
760:                 $properties[] = $tag->getVariableName();
761:             } elseif ($name == 'method') {
762:                 $methods[] = $tag->getMethodName();
763:             }
764:         }
765: 
766:         foreach ($this->properties as $name => $property) {
767:             $name = "\$$name";
768: 
769:             if ($this->hasCamelCaseModelProperties()) {
770:                 $name = Str::camel($name);
771:             }
772: 
773:             if (in_array($name, $properties)) {
774:                 continue;
775:             }
776:             if ($property['read'] && $property['write']) {
777:                 $attr = 'property';
778:             } elseif ($property['write']) {
779:                 $attr = 'property-write';
780:             } else {
781:                 $attr = 'property-read';
782:             }
783: 
784:             $tagLine = trim("@{$attr} {$property['type']} {$name} {$property['comment']}");
785:             $tag = Tag::createInstance($tagLine, $phpdoc);
786:             $phpdoc->appendTag($tag);
787:         }

789:         ksort($this->methods);
790: 
791:         foreach ($this->methods as $name => $method) {
792:             if (in_array($name, $methods)) {
793:                 continue;
794:             }
795:             $arguments = implode(', ', $method['arguments']);
796:             $tag = Tag::createInstance("@method static {$method['type']} {$name}({$arguments})", $phpdoc);
797:             $phpdoc->appendTag($tag);
798:         }

800:         if ($this->write && !$phpdoc->getTagsByName('mixin')) {
801:             $eloquentClassNameInModel = $this->getClassNameInDestinationFile($reflection, 'Eloquent');

804:         if ($this->phpstorm_noinspections) {
805:             /**
806:              * Facades, Eloquent API
807:              * @see https://www.jetbrains.com/help/phpstorm/php-fully-qualified-name-usage.html
808:              */

811:              * Relations, other models in the same namespace

813:              */
814:             $phpdoc->appendTag(
815:                 Tag::createInstance('@noinspection PhpUnnecessaryFullyQualifiedNameInspection', $phpdoc)
816:             );
817:         }

819:         $serializer = new DocBlockSerializer();
820:         $serializer->getDocComment($phpdoc);
821:         $docComment = $serializer->getDocComment($phpdoc);
822: 
823: 
824:         if ($this->write) {
825:             $filename = $reflection->getFileName();
826:             $contents = $this->files->get($filename);
827:             if ($originalDoc) {
828:                 $contents = str_replace($originalDoc, $docComment, $contents);
829:             } else {
830:                 $replace = "{$docComment}\n";
831:                 $pos = strpos($contents, "final class {$classname}") ?: strpos($contents, "class {$classname}");
832:                 if ($pos !== false) {
833:                     $contents = substr_replace($contents, $replace, $pos, 0);

843:         if ($interfaceNames) {
844:             $interfaces = implode(', \\', $interfaceNames);

1: # Laravel IDE Helper Generator
2: 
3: [![Latest Version on Packagist][ico-version]][link-packagist]
4: [![Software License][ico-license]](LICENSE.md)
5: [![Build Status][ico-gha]][link-gha]
6: [![Total Downloads][ico-downloads]][link-downloads]
7: 
8: **Complete PHPDocs, directly from the source**
9: 
10: This package generates helper files that enable your IDE to provide accurate autocompletion.
11: Generation is done based on the files in your project, so they are always up-to-date.
12: 
13: - [Installation](#installation)
14: - [Usage](#usage)
15:   - [Automatic PHPDoc generation for Laravel Facades](#automatic-phpdoc-generation-for-laravel-facades)
16:   - [Automatic PHPDocs for models](#automatic-phpdocs-for-models)
17:   - [Automatic PHPDocs generation for Laravel Fluent methods](#automatic-phpdocs-generation-for-laravel-fluent-methods)
18:   - [Auto-completion for factory builders](#auto-completion-for-factory-builders)
19:   - [PhpStorm Meta for Container instances](#phpstorm-meta-for-container-instances)
20: - [Usage with Lumen](#usage-with-lumen)
21:   - [Enabling Facades](#enabling-facades)
22:   - [Adding the Service Provider](#adding-the-service-provider)
23:   - [Adding Additional Facades](#adding-additional-facades)
24: - [License](#license)
25: 
26: ## Installation
27: 
28: Require this package with composer using the following command:
29: 
30: ```bash
31: composer require --dev barryvdh/laravel-ide-helper
32: ```
33: 
34: This package makes use of [Laravels package auto-discovery mechanism](https://medium.com/@taylorotwell/package-auto-discovery-in-laravel-5-5-ea9e3ab20518), which means if you don't install dev dependencies in production, it also won't be loaded.
35: 
36: If for some reason you want manually control this:
37: - add the package to the `extra.laravel.dont-discover` key in `composer.json`, e.g.
38:   ```json
39:   "extra": {
40:     "laravel": {
41:       "dont-discover": [
42:         "barryvdh/laravel-ide-helper"
43:       ]
44:     }
45:   }
46:   ```
47: - Add the following class to the `providers` array in `config/app.php`:
48:   ```php
49:   Barryvdh\LaravelIdeHelper\IdeHelperServiceProvider::class,
50:   ```
51:   If you want to manually load it only in non-production environments, instead you can add this to your `AppServiceProvider` with the `register()` method:
52:   ```php
53:   public function register()
54:   {
55:       if ($this->app->environment() !== 'production') {
56:           $this->app->register(\Barryvdh\LaravelIdeHelper\IdeHelperServiceProvider::class);
57:       }
58:       // ...
59:   }
60:   ```
61: 
62: > Note: Avoid caching the configuration in your development environment, it may cause issues after installing this package; respectively clear the cache beforehand via `php artisan cache:clear` if you encounter problems when running the commands
63: 
64: ## Usage
65: 
66: _Check out [this Laracasts video](https://laracasts.com/series/how-to-be-awesome-in-phpstorm/episodes/15) for a quick introduction/explanation!_
67: 
68: - [`php artisan ide-helper:generate` - PHPDoc generation for Laravel Facades ](#automatic-phpdoc-generation-for-laravel-facades)
69: - [`php artisan ide-helper:models` - PHPDocs for models](#automatic-PHPDocs-for-models)
70: - [`php artisan ide-helper:meta` - PhpStorm Meta file](#phpstorm-meta-for-container-instances)
71: 
72: 
73: Note: You do need CodeComplice for Sublime Text: https://github.com/spectacles/CodeComplice
74: 
75: ### Automatic PHPDoc generation for Laravel Facades
76: 
77: You can now re-generate the docs yourself (for future updates)
78: 
79: ```bash
80: php artisan ide-helper:generate
81: ```
82: 
83: Note: `bootstrap/compiled.php` has to be cleared first, so run `php artisan clear-compiled` before generating.
84: 
85: This will generate the file `_ide_helper.php` which is expected to be additionally parsed by your IDE for autocomplete. You can use the config `filename` to change its name.
86: 
87: You can configure your `composer.json` to do this each time you update your dependencies:
88: 
89: ```js
90: "scripts": {
91:     "post-update-cmd": [
92:         "Illuminate\\Foundation\\ComposerScripts::postUpdate",
93:         "@php artisan ide-helper:generate",
94:         "@php artisan ide-helper:meta"
95:     ]
96: },
97: ```
98: 
99: You can also publish the config file to change implementations (ie. interface to specific class) or set defaults for `--helpers`.
100: 
101: ```bash
102: php artisan vendor:publish --provider="Barryvdh\LaravelIdeHelper\IdeHelperServiceProvider" --tag=config
103: ```
104: 
105: The generator tries to identify the real class, but if it cannot be found, you can define it in the config file.
106: 
107: Some classes need a working database connection. If you do not have a default working connection, some facades will not be included.
108: You can use an in-memory SQLite driver by adding the `-M` option.
109: 
110: You can choose to include helper files. This is not enabled by default, but you can override it with the `--helpers (-H)` option.
111: The `Illuminate/Support/helpers.php` is already set up, but you can add/remove your own files in the config file.
112: 
113: ### Automatic PHPDocs for models
114: 
115: If you don't want to write your properties yourself, you can use the command `php artisan ide-helper:models` to generate
116: PHPDocs, based on table columns, relations and getters/setters.
117: 
118: > Note: this command requires a working database connection to introspect the table of each model
119: 
120: By default, you are asked to overwrite or write to a separate file (`_ide_helper_models.php`).
121: You can write the comments directly to your Model file, using the `--write (-W)` option, or
122: force to not write with `--nowrite (-N)`.
123: 
124: > Please make sure to back up your models, before writing the info.
125: 
126: Writing to the models should keep the existing comments and only append new properties/methods.
127: The existing PHPDoc is replaced, or added if not found.
128: With the `--reset (-R)` option, the existing PHPDocs are ignored, and only the newly found columns/relations are saved as PHPDocs.
129: 
130: ```bash
131: php artisan ide-helper:models "App\Models\Post"
132: ```
133: 
134: ```php
135: /**
136:  * App\Models\Post
137:  *
138:  * @property integer $id
139:  * @property integer $author_id
140:  * @property string $title
141:  * @property string $text
142:  * @property \Illuminate\Support\Carbon $created_at
143:  * @property \Illuminate\Support\Carbon $updated_at
144:  * @property-read \User $author
145:  * @property-read \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection|\Comment[] $comments
146:  * @method static \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder|\App\Models\Post newModelQuery()
147:  * @method static \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder|\App\Models\Post newQuery()
148:  * @method static \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder|\App\Models\Post query()
149:  * @method static \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder|\App\Models\Post whereTitle($value)
150:  * …
151:  */
152: ```
153: 
154: By default, models in `app/models` are scanned. The optional argument tells what models to use (also outside app/models).
155: 
156: ```bash
157: php artisan ide-helper:models "App\Models\Post" "App\Models\User"
158: ```
159: 
160: You can also scan a different directory, using the `--dir` option (relative from the base path):
161: 
162: ```bash
163: php artisan ide-helper:models --dir="path/to/models" --dir="app/src/Model"
164: ```
165: 
166: You can publish the config file (`php artisan vendor:publish`) and set the default directories.
167: 
168: Models can be ignored using the `--ignore (-I)` option
169: 
170: ```bash
171: php artisan ide-helper:models --ignore="App\Models\Post,App\Models\User"
172: ```
173: 
174: Or can be ignored by setting the `ignored_models` config
175: 
176: ```php
177: 'ignored_models' => [
178:     App\Post::class,
179:     Api\User::class
180: ],
181: ```
182: 
183: #### Magic `where*` methods
184: 
185: Eloquent allows calling `where<Attribute>` on your modes, e.g. `Post::whereTitle(…)` and automatically translates this to e.g. `Post::where('title', '=', '…')`.
186: 
187: If for some reason it's undesired to have them generated (one for each column), you can disable this via config `write_model_magic_where` and setting it to `false`.
188: 
189: #### Magic `*_count` properties
190: 
191: You may use the [`::withCount`](https://laravel.com/docs/master/eloquent-relationships#counting-related-models) method to count the number results from a relationship without actually loading them. Those results are then placed in attributes following the `<columname>_count` convention.
192: 
193: By default, these attributes are generated in the phpdoc. You can turn them off by setting the config `write_model_relation_count_properties` to `false`.
194: 
195: #### Unsupported or custom database types
196: 
197: Common column types (e.g. varchar, integer) are correctly mapped to PHP types (`string`, `int`).
198: 
199: But sometimes you may want to use custom column types in your database like `geography`, `jsonb`, `citext`, `bit`, etc. which may throw an "Unknown database type"-Exception.
200: 
201: For those special cases, you can map them via the config `custom_db_types`. Example:
202: ```php
203: 'custom_db_types' => [
204:     'mysql' => [
205:         'geography' => 'array',
206:         'point' => 'array',
207:     ],
208:     'postgresql' => [
209:         'jsonb' => 'string',
210:         '_int4' => 'array',
211:     ],
212: ],
213: ```
214: 
215: ### Automatic PHPDocs generation for Laravel Fluent methods
216: 
217: If you need PHPDocs support for Fluent methods in migration, for example
218: 
219: ```php
220: $table->string("somestring")->nullable()->index();
221: ```
222: 
223: After publishing vendor, simply change the `include_fluent` line your `config/ide-helper.php` file into:
224: 
225: ```php
226: 'include_fluent' => true,
227: ```
228: 
229: Then run `php artisan ide-helper:generate`, you will now see all Fluent methods recognized by your IDE.
230: 
231: ### Auto-completion for factory builders
232: 
233: If you would like the `factory()->create()` and `factory()->make()` methods to return the correct model class,
234: you can enable custom factory builders with the `include_factory_builders` line your `config/ide-helper.php` file.
235: 
236: ```php
237: 'include_factory_builders' => true,
238: ```
239: 
240: For this to work, you must also publish the PhpStorm Meta file (see below).
241: 
242: ## PhpStorm Meta for Container instances
243: 
244: It's possible to generate a PhpStorm meta file to [add support for factory design pattern](https://www.jetbrains.com/help/phpstorm/ide-advanced-metadata.html).
245: For Laravel, this means we can make PhpStorm understand what kind of object we are resolving from the IoC Container.
246: For example, `events` will return an `Illuminate\Events\Dispatcher` object,
247: so with the meta file you can call `app('events')` and it will autocomplete the Dispatcher methods.
248: 
249: ```bash
250: php artisan ide-helper:meta
251: ```
252: 
253: ```php
254: app('events')->fire();
255: \App::make('events')->fire();
256: 
257: /** @var \Illuminate\Foundation\Application $app */
258: $app->make('events')->fire();
259: 
260: // When the key is not found, it uses the argument as class name
261: app('App\SomeClass');
262: // Also works with
263: app(App\SomeClass::class);
264: ```
265: 
266: > Note: You might need to restart PhpStorm and make sure `.phpstorm.meta.php` is indexed.
267: >

273: ## Usage with Lumen
274: 
275: This package is focused on Laravel development, but it can also be used in Lumen with some workarounds.
276: Because Lumen works a little different, as it is like a bare bone version of Laravel and the main configuration
277: parameters are instead located in `bootstrap/app.php`, some alterations must be made.
278: 
279: ### Enabling Facades
280: 
281: While Laravel IDE Helper can generate automatically default Facades for code hinting,
282: Lumen doesn't come with Facades activated. If you plan in using them, you must enable
283: them under the `Create The Application` section, uncommenting this line:
284: 
285: ```php
286: // $app->withFacades();
287: ```
288: 
289: From there, you should be able to use the `create_alias()` function to add additional Facades into your application.
290: 
291: ### Adding the Service Provider
292: 
293: You can install Laravel IDE Helper in `app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php`,
294: and uncommenting this line that registers the App Service Providers, so it can properly load.
295: 
296: ```php
297: // $app->register(App\Providers\AppServiceProvider::class);
298: ```
299: 
300: If you are not using that line, that is usually handy to manage gracefully multiple Laravel/Lumen installations,
301: you will have to add this line of code under the `Register Service Providers` section of your `bootstrap/app.php`.
302: 
303: ```php
304: if ($app->environment() !== 'production') {
305:     $app->register(\Barryvdh\LaravelIdeHelper\IdeHelperServiceProvider::class);
306: }
307: ```
308: 
309: After that, Laravel IDE Helper should work correctly. During the generation process,
310: the script may throw exceptions saying that some Class(s) doesn't exist or there are some undefined indexes.
311: This is normal, as Lumen has some default packages stripped away, like Cookies, Storage and Session.
312: If you plan to add these packages, you will have to add them manually and create additional Facades if needed.
313: 
314: ### Adding Additional Facades
315: 
316: Currently, Lumen IDE Helper doesn't take into account additional Facades created under `bootstrap/app.php` using `create_alias()`,
317: so you need to create a `config/app.php` file and add your custom aliases under an `aliases` array again, like so:
318: 
319: ```php
320: return [
321:     'aliases' => [
322:         'CustomAliasOne' => Example\Support\Facades\CustomAliasOne::class,
323:         'CustomAliasTwo' => Example\Support\Facades\CustomAliasTwo::class,
324:         //...
325:     ]
326: ];
327: ```
328: 
329: After you run `php artisan ide-helper:generate`, it's recommended (but not mandatory) to rename `config/app.php` to something else,
330: until you have to re-generate the docs or after passing to production environment.
331: Lumen 5.1+ will read this file for configuration parameters if it is present, and may overlap some configurations if it is completely populated.

184:     protected function generateDocs($loadModels, $ignore = '')
185:     {
186: 
187: 
188:         $output = "<?php
189: 
190: // @formatter:off
191: /**
192:  * A helper file for your Eloquent Models
193:  * Copy the phpDocs from this file to the correct Model,
194:  * And remove them from this file, to prevent double declarations.
195:  *
196:  * @author Barry vd. Heuvel <barryvdh@gmail.com>
197:  */
198: \n\n";
199: 
200:         $hasDoctrine = interface_exists('Doctrine\DBAL\Driver');
201: 
202:         if (empty($loadModels)) {
203:             $models = $this->loadModels();
204:         } else {
205:             $models = [];
206:             foreach ($loadModels as $model) {
207:                 $models = array_merge($models, explode(',', $model));
208:             }
209:         }
210: 
211:         $ignore = array_merge(
212:             explode(',', $ignore),
213:             $this->laravel['config']->get('ide-helper.ignored_models', [])
214:         );
215: 
216:         foreach ($models as $name) {
217:             if (in_array($name, $ignore)) {
218:                 if ($this->output->getVerbosity() >= OutputInterface::VERBOSITY_VERBOSE) {
219:                     $this->comment("Ignoring model '$name'");
220:                 }
221:                 continue;
222:             }
223:             $this->properties = [];
224:             $this->methods = [];
225:             if (class_exists($name)) {
226:                 try {
227:                     // handle abstract classes, interfaces, ...
228:                     $reflectionClass = new ReflectionClass($name);
229: 
230:                     if (!$reflectionClass->isSubclassOf('Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model')) {
231:                         continue;
232:                     }
233: 
234:                     $this->comment("Loading model '$name'", OutputInterface::VERBOSITY_VERBOSE);
235: 
236:                     if (!$reflectionClass->IsInstantiable()) {
237:                         // ignore abstract class or interface
238:                         continue;
239:                     }
240: 
241:                     $model = $this->laravel->make($name);
242: 
243:                     if ($hasDoctrine) {
244:                         $this->getPropertiesFromTable($model);
245:                     }
246: 
247:                     if (method_exists($model, 'getCasts')) {
248:                         $this->castPropertiesType($model);
249:                     }
250: 
251:                     $this->getPropertiesFromMethods($model);
252:                     $this->getSoftDeleteMethods($model);
253:                     $this->getCollectionMethods($model);
254:                     $output                .= $this->createPhpDocs($name);
255:                     $ignore[]              = $name;
256:                     $this->nullableColumns = [];
257:                 } catch (\Throwable $e) {
258:                     $this->error('Exception: ' . $e->getMessage() .
259:                         "\nCould not analyze class $name.\n\nTrace:\n" .
260:                         $e->getTraceAsString());
261:                 }
262:             }
263:         }
264: 
265:         if (!$hasDoctrine) {
266:             $this->error(
267:                 'Warning: `"doctrine/dbal": "~2.3"` is required to load database information. ' .
268:                 'Please require that in your composer.json and run `composer update`.'
269:             );
270:         }
271: 
272:         return $output;
273:     }

276:     protected function loadModels()
277:     {
278:         $models = [];
279:         foreach ($this->dirs as $dir) {
280:             if (is_dir(base_path($dir))) {
281:                 $dir = base_path($dir);
282:             }
283: 
284:             if (!is_dir($dir)) {
285:                 $this->error("Cannot locate directory '{'$dir}'");
286:                 continue;
287:             }
288: 
289:             $dirs = glob($dir, GLOB_ONLYDIR);
290:             foreach ($dirs as $dir) {
291:                 if (file_exists($dir)) {
292:                     $classMap = ClassMapGenerator::createMap($dir);
293: 
294:                     // Sort list so it's stable across different environments
295:                     ksort($classMap);
296: 
297:                     foreach ($classMap as $model => $path) {
298:                         $models[] = $model;
299:                     }
300:                 }
301:             }
302:         }
303:         return $models;
304:     }

306:     /**
307:      * cast the properties's type from $casts.
308:      *
309:      * @param \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model $model
310:      */
311:     protected function castPropertiesType($model)
312:     {
313:         $casts = $model->getCasts();
314:         foreach ($casts as $name => $type) {
315:             switch ($type) {
316:                 case 'boolean':
317:                 case 'bool':
318:                     $realType = 'boolean';
319:                     break;
320:                 case 'string':
321:                     $realType = 'string';
322:                     break;
323:                 case 'array':
324:                 case 'json':
325:                     $realType = 'array';
326:                     break;
327:                 case 'object':
328:                     $realType = 'object';
329:                     break;
330:                 case 'int':
331:                 case 'integer':
332:                 case 'timestamp':
333:                     $realType = 'integer';
334:                     break;
335:                 case 'real':
336:                 case 'double':
337:                 case 'float':
338:                     $realType = 'float';
339:                     break;
340:                 case 'date':
341:                 case 'datetime':
342:                     $realType = $this->dateClass;
343:                     break;
344:                 case 'collection':
345:                     $realType = '\Illuminate\Support\Collection';
346:                     break;
347:                 default:
348:                     $realType = class_exists($type) ? ('\\' . $type) : 'mixed';
349:                     break;
350:             }
351: 
352:             if (!isset($this->properties[$name])) {
353:                 continue;
354:             }
355: 
356:             $realType = $this->checkForCustomLaravelCasts($realType);
357:             $realType = $this->getTypeOverride($realType);
358:             $this->properties[$name]['type'] = $this->getTypeInModel($model, $realType);
359: 
360:             if (isset($this->nullableColumns[$name])) {
361:                 $this->properties[$name]['type'] .= '|null';
362:             }
363:         }
364:     }

367:      * Returns the override type for the give type.
368:      *
369:      * @param string $type
370:      * @return string|null
371:      */

373:     {
374:         $typeOverrides = $this->laravel['config']->get('ide-helper.type_overrides', []);
375: 
376:         return $typeOverrides[$type] ?? $type;

379:     /**
380:      * Load the properties from the database table.
381:      *
382:      * @param \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model $model
383:      */
384:     protected function getPropertiesFromTable($model)
385:     {
386:         $table = $model->getConnection()->getTablePrefix() . $model->getTable();
387:         $schema = $model->getConnection()->getDoctrineSchemaManager();
388:         $databasePlatform = $schema->getDatabasePlatform();
389:         $databasePlatform->registerDoctrineTypeMapping('enum', 'string');
390: 
391:         $platformName = $databasePlatform->getName();
392:         $customTypes = $this->laravel['config']->get("ide-helper.custom_db_types.{$platformName}", []);
393:         foreach ($customTypes as $yourTypeName => $doctrineTypeName) {
394:             $databasePlatform->registerDoctrineTypeMapping($yourTypeName, $doctrineTypeName);
395:         }
396: 
397:         $database = null;
398:         if (strpos($table, '.')) {
399:             list($database, $table) = explode('.', $table);
400:         }
401: 
402:         $columns = $schema->listTableColumns($table, $database);
403: 
404:         if (!$columns) {
405:             return;
406:         }
407: 
408:         foreach ($columns as $column) {
409:             $name = $column->getName();
410:             if (in_array($name, $model->getDates())) {
411:                 $type = $this->dateClass;
412:             } else {
413:                 $type = $column->getType()->getName();
414:                 switch ($type) {
415:                     case 'string':
416:                     case 'text':
417:                     case 'date':
418:                     case 'time':
419:                     case 'guid':
420:                     case 'datetimetz':
421:                     case 'datetime':
422:                     case 'decimal':
423:                         $type = 'string';
424:                         break;
425:                     case 'integer':
426:                     case 'bigint':
427:                     case 'smallint':
428:                         $type = 'integer';
429:                         break;
430:                     case 'boolean':
431:                         switch (config('database.default')) {
432:                             case 'sqlite':
433:                             case 'mysql':
434:                                 $type = 'integer';
435:                                 break;
436:                             default:
437:                                 $type = 'boolean';
438:                                 break;
439:                         }
440:                         break;
441:                     case 'float':
442:                         $type = 'float';
443:                         break;
444:                     default:
445:                         $type = 'mixed';
446:                         break;
447:                 }
448:             }
449: 
450:             $comment = $column->getComment();
451:             if (!$column->getNotnull()) {
452:                 $this->nullableColumns[$name] = true;
453:             }
454:             $this->setProperty(
455:                 $name,
456:                 $this->getTypeInModel($model, $type),
457:                 true,
458:                 true,
459:                 $comment,
460:                 !$column->getNotnull()
461:             );
462:             if ($this->write_model_magic_where) {
463:                 $this->setMethod(
464:                     Str::camel('where_' . $name),
465:                     $this->getClassNameInDestinationFile($model, \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder::class)
466:                     . '|'
467:                     . $this->getClassNameInDestinationFile($model, get_class($model)),
468:                     ['$value']
469:                 );
470:             }
471:         }
472:     }

474:     /**
475:      * @param \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model $model
476:      */
477:     protected function getPropertiesFromMethods($model)
478:     {
479:         $methods = get_class_methods($model);
480:         if ($methods) {
481:             sort($methods);
482:             foreach ($methods as $method) {
483:                 if (
484:                     Str::startsWith($method, 'get') && Str::endsWith(
485:                         $method,
486:                         'Attribute'
487:                     ) && $method !== 'getAttribute'
488:                 ) {
489:                     //Magic get<name>Attribute
490:                     $name = Str::snake(substr($method, 3, -9));
491:                     if (!empty($name)) {
492:                         $reflection = new \ReflectionMethod($model, $method);
493:                         $type = $this->getReturnType($reflection);
494:                         $type = $this->getTypeInModel($model, $type);
495:                         $this->setProperty($name, $type, true, null);
496:                     }
497:                 } elseif (
498:                     Str::startsWith($method, 'set') && Str::endsWith(
499:                         $method,
500:                         'Attribute'
501:                     ) && $method !== 'setAttribute'
502:                 ) {
503:                     //Magic set<name>Attribute
504:                     $name = Str::snake(substr($method, 3, -9));
505:                     if (!empty($name)) {
506:                         $this->setProperty($name, null, null, true);
507:                     }
508:                 } elseif (Str::startsWith($method, 'scope') && $method !== 'scopeQuery') {
509:                     //Magic set<name>Attribute
510:                     $name = Str::camel(substr($method, 5));
511:                     if (!empty($name)) {
512:                         $reflection = new \ReflectionMethod($model, $method);
513:                         $args = $this->getParameters($reflection);
514:                         //Remove the first ($query) argument
515:                         array_shift($args);
516:                         $builder = $this->getClassNameInDestinationFile(
517:                             $reflection->getDeclaringClass(),
518:                             \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder::class
519:                         );
520:                         $modelName = $this->getClassNameInDestinationFile(
521:                             $reflection->getDeclaringClass(),
522:                             $reflection->getDeclaringClass()->getName()
523:                         );
524:                         $this->setMethod($name, $builder . '|' . $modelName, $args);
525:                     }
526:                 } elseif (in_array($method, ['query', 'newQuery', 'newModelQuery'])) {
527:                     $builder = $this->getClassNameInDestinationFile($model, get_class($model->newModelQuery()));
528: 
529:                     $this->setMethod(
530:                         $method,
531:                         $builder . '|' . $this->getClassNameInDestinationFile($model, get_class($model))
532:                     );
533:                 } elseif (
534:                     !method_exists('Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model', $method)
535:                     && !Str::startsWith($method, 'get')
536:                 ) {
537:                     //Use reflection to inspect the code, based on Illuminate/Support/SerializableClosure.php
538:                     $reflection = new \ReflectionMethod($model, $method);
539: 
540:                     if ($returnType = $reflection->getReturnType()) {
541:                         $type = $returnType instanceof \ReflectionNamedType
542:                             ? $returnType->getName()
543:                             : (string)$returnType;
544:                     } else {
545:                         // php 7.x type or fallback to docblock
546:                         $type = (string)$this->getReturnTypeFromDocBlock($reflection);
547:                     }
548: 
549:                     $file = new \SplFileObject($reflection->getFileName());
550:                     $file->seek($reflection->getStartLine() - 1);
551: 
552:                     $code = '';
553:                     while ($file->key() < $reflection->getEndLine()) {
554:                         $code .= $file->current();
555:                         $file->next();
556:                     }
557:                     $code = trim(preg_replace('/\s\s+/', '', $code));
558:                     $begin = strpos($code, 'function(');
559:                     $code = substr($code, $begin, strrpos($code, '}') - $begin + 1);
560: 
561:                     foreach (
562:                         [
563:                                'hasMany' => '\Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasMany',
564:                                'hasManyThrough' => '\Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasManyThrough',
565:                                'hasOneThrough' => '\Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasOneThrough',
566:                                'belongsToMany' => '\Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsToMany',
567:                                'hasOne' => '\Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasOne',
568:                                'belongsTo' => '\Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo',
569:                                'morphOne' => '\Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\MorphOne',
570:                                'morphTo' => '\Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\MorphTo',
571:                                'morphMany' => '\Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\MorphMany',
572:                                'morphToMany' => '\Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\MorphToMany',
573:                                'morphedByMany' => '\Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\MorphToMany',
574:                              ] as $relation => $impl
575:                     ) {
576:                         $search = '$this->' . $relation . '(';
577:                         if (stripos($code, $search) || ltrim($impl, '\\') === ltrim((string)$type, '\\')) {
578:                             //Resolve the relation's model to a Relation object.
579:                             $methodReflection = new \ReflectionMethod($model, $method);
580:                             if ($methodReflection->getNumberOfParameters()) {
581:                                 continue;
582:                             }
583: 
584:                             // Adding constraints requires reading model properties which
585:                             // can cause errors. Since we don't need constraints we can
586:                             // disable them when we fetch the relation to avoid errors.
587:                             $relationObj = Relation::noConstraints(function () use ($model, $method) {
588:                                 try {
589:                                     return $model->$method();
590:                                 } catch (\Throwable $e) {
591:                                     return null;
592:                                 }
593:                             });
594: 
595:                             if ($relationObj instanceof Relation) {
596:                                 $relatedModel = $this->getClassNameInDestinationFile(
597:                                     $model,
598:                                     get_class($relationObj->getRelated())
599:                                 );
600: 
601:                                 $relations = [
602:                                     'hasManyThrough',
603:                                     'belongsToMany',
604:                                     'hasMany',
605:                                     'morphMany',
606:                                     'morphToMany',
607:                                     'morphedByMany',
608:                                 ];
609:                                 if (strpos(get_class($relationObj), 'Many') !== false) {
610:                                     //Collection or array of models (because Collection is Arrayable)
611:                                     $relatedClass = '\\' . get_class($relationObj->getRelated());
612:                                     $collectionClass = $this->getCollectionClass($relatedClass);
613:                                     $collectionClassNameInModel = $this->getClassNameInDestinationFile(
614:                                         $model,
615:                                         $collectionClass
616:                                     );
617:                                     $this->setProperty(
618:                                         $method,
619:                                         $collectionClassNameInModel . '|' . $relatedModel . '[]',
620:                                         true,
621:                                         null
622:                                     );
623:                                     if ($this->write_model_relation_count_properties) {
624:                                         $this->setProperty(
625:                                             Str::snake($method) . '_count',
626:                                             'int|null',
627:                                             true,
628:                                             false
629:                                         );
630:                                     }
631:                                 } elseif ($relation === 'morphTo') {
632:                                     // Model isn't specified because relation is polymorphic
633:                                     $this->setProperty(
634:                                         $method,
635:                                         $this->getClassNameInDestinationFile($model, Model::class) . '|\Eloquent',
636:                                         true,
637:                                         null
638:                                     );
639:                                 } else {
640:                                     //Single model is returned
641:                                     $this->setProperty(
642:                                         $method,
643:                                         $relatedModel,
644:                                         true,
645:                                         null,
646:                                         '',
647:                                         $this->isRelationNullable($relation, $relationObj)
648:                                     );
649:                                 }
650:                             }
651:                         }
652:                     }
653:                 }
654:             }
655:         }
656:     }

658:     /**
659:      * Check if the relation is nullable
660:      *
661:      * @param string   $relation
662:      * @param Relation $relationObj
663:      *
664:      * @return bool
665:      */
666:     protected function isRelationNullable(string $relation, Relation $relationObj): bool
667:     {
668:         $reflectionObj = new ReflectionObject($relationObj);
669: 
670:         if (in_array($relation, ['hasOne', 'hasOneThrough', 'morphOne'], true)) {
671:             $defaultProp = $reflectionObj->getProperty('withDefault');
672:             $defaultProp->setAccessible(true);
673: 
674:             return !$defaultProp->getValue($relationObj);
675:         }
676: 
677:         if (!$reflectionObj->hasProperty('foreignKey')) {
678:             return false;
679:         }
680: 
681:         $fkProp = $reflectionObj->getProperty('foreignKey');
682:         $fkProp->setAccessible(true);
683: 
684:         return isset($this->nullableColumns[$fkProp->getValue($relationObj)]);
685:     }

687:     /**
688:      * @param string      $name
689:      * @param string|null $type
690:      * @param bool|null   $read
691:      * @param bool|null   $write
692:      * @param string|null $comment
693:      * @param bool        $nullable
694:      */
695:     protected function setProperty($name, $type = null, $read = null, $write = null, $comment = '', $nullable = false)
696:     {
697:         if (!isset($this->properties[$name])) {
698:             $this->properties[$name] = [];
699:             $this->properties[$name]['type'] = 'mixed';
700:             $this->properties[$name]['read'] = false;
701:             $this->properties[$name]['write'] = false;
702:             $this->properties[$name]['comment'] = (string) $comment;
703:         }
704:         if ($type !== null) {
705:             $newType = $this->getTypeOverride($type);
706:             if ($nullable) {
707:                 $newType .= '|null';
708:             }
709:             $this->properties[$name]['type'] = $newType;
710:         }
711:         if ($read !== null) {
712:             $this->properties[$name]['read'] = $read;
713:         }
714:         if ($write !== null) {
715:             $this->properties[$name]['write'] = $write;
716:         }
717:     }

719:     protected function setMethod($name, $type = '', $arguments = [])
720:     {
721:         $methods = array_change_key_case($this->methods, CASE_LOWER);
722: 
723:         if (!isset($methods[strtolower($name)])) {
724:             $this->methods[$name] = [];
725:             $this->methods[$name]['type'] = $type;
726:             $this->methods[$name]['arguments'] = $arguments;
727:         }
728:     }

730:     /**
731:      * @param string $class
732:      * @return string
733:      */
734:     protected function createPhpDocs($class)
735:     {
736: 
737:         $reflection = new ReflectionClass($class);
738:         $namespace = $reflection->getNamespaceName();
739:         $classname = $reflection->getShortName();
740:         $originalDoc = $reflection->getDocComment();
741:         $keyword = $this->getClassKeyword($reflection);
742:         $interfaceNames = array_diff_key(
743:             $reflection->getInterfaceNames(),
744:             $reflection->getParentClass()->getInterfaceNames()
745:         );
746: 
747:         if ($this->reset) {
748:             $phpdoc = new DocBlock('', new Context($namespace));
749:             if ($this->keep_text) {
750:                 $phpdoc->setText(
751:                     (new DocBlock($reflection, new Context($namespace)))->getText()
752:                 );
753:             }
754:         } else {
755:             $phpdoc = new DocBlock($reflection, new Context($namespace));
756:         }
757: 
758:         if (!$phpdoc->getText()) {
759:             $phpdoc->setText($class);
760:         }
761: 
762:         $properties = [];
763:         $methods = [];
764:         foreach ($phpdoc->getTags() as $tag) {
765:             $name = $tag->getName();
766:             if ($name == 'property' || $name == 'property-read' || $name == 'property-write') {
767:                 $properties[] = $tag->getVariableName();
768:             } elseif ($name == 'method') {
769:                 $methods[] = $tag->getMethodName();
770:             }
771:         }
772: 
773:         foreach ($this->properties as $name => $property) {
774:             $name = "\$$name";
775: 
776:             if ($this->hasCamelCaseModelProperties()) {
777:                 $name = Str::camel($name);
778:             }
779: 
780:             if (in_array($name, $properties)) {
781:                 continue;
782:             }
783:             if ($property['read'] && $property['write']) {
784:                 $attr = 'property';
785:             } elseif ($property['write']) {
786:                 $attr = 'property-write';
787:             } else {
788:                 $attr = 'property-read';
789:             }
790: 
791:             $tagLine = trim("@{$attr} {$property['type']} {$name} {$property['comment']}");
792:             $tag = Tag::createInstance($tagLine, $phpdoc);
793:             $phpdoc->appendTag($tag);
794:         }
795: 
796:         ksort($this->methods);
797: 
798:         foreach ($this->methods as $name => $method) {
799:             if (in_array($name, $methods)) {
800:                 continue;
801:             }
802:             $arguments = implode(', ', $method['arguments']);
803:             $tag = Tag::createInstance("@method static {$method['type']} {$name}({$arguments})", $phpdoc);
804:             $phpdoc->appendTag($tag);
805:         }
806: 
807:         if ($this->write && !$phpdoc->getTagsByName('mixin')) {
808:             $eloquentClassNameInModel = $this->getClassNameInDestinationFile($reflection, 'Eloquent');

253:                     $this->getCollectionMethods($model);
254:                     $output                .= $this->createPhpDocs($name);
255:                     $ignore[]              = $name;
256:                     $this->nullableColumns = [];
257:                 } catch (\Throwable $e) {
258:                     $this->error('Exception: ' . $e->getMessage() .
259:                         "\nCould not analyze class $name.\n\nTrace:\n" .
260:                         $e->getTraceAsString());
261:                 }
262:             }
263:         }
264: 
265:         if (!$hasDoctrine) {
266:             $this->error(
267:                 'Warning: `"doctrine/dbal": "~2.3"` is required to load database information. ' .
268:                 'Please require that in your composer.json and run `composer update`.'
269:             );
270:         }
271: 
272:         return $output;
273:     }

306:     /**
307:      * cast the properties's type from $casts.
308:      *
309:      * @param \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model $model
310:      */
311:     protected function castPropertiesType($model)
312:     {
313:         $casts = $model->getCasts();
314:         foreach ($casts as $name => $type) {
315:             switch ($type) {
316:                 case 'boolean':
317:                 case 'bool':
318:                     $realType = 'boolean';
319:                     break;
320:                 case 'string':
321:                     $realType = 'string';
322:                     break;
323:                 case 'array':
324:                 case 'json':
325:                     $realType = 'array';
326:                     break;
327:                 case 'object':
328:                     $realType = 'object';
329:                     break;
330:                 case 'int':
331:                 case 'integer':
332:                 case 'timestamp':
333:                     $realType = 'integer';
334:                     break;
335:                 case 'real':
336:                 case 'double':
337:                 case 'float':
338:                     $realType = 'float';
339:                     break;
340:                 case 'date':
341:                 case 'datetime':
342:                     $realType = $this->dateClass;
343:                     break;
344:                 case 'collection':
345:                     $realType = '\Illuminate\Support\Collection';
346:                     break;
347:                 default:
348:                     $realType = class_exists($type) ? ('\\' . $type) : 'mixed';
349:                     break;
350:             }
351: 
352:             if (!isset($this->properties[$name])) {
353:                 continue;
354:             }
355: 
356:             $realType = $this->checkForCustomLaravelCasts($realType);
357:             $realType = $this->getTypeOverride($realType);
358:             $this->properties[$name]['type'] = $this->getTypeInModel($model, $realType);
359: 
360:             if (isset($this->nullableColumns[$name])) {
361:                 $this->properties[$name]['type'] .= '|null';
362:             }
363:         }
364:     }

379:     /**
380:      * Load the properties from the database table.
381:      *
382:      * @param \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model $model
383:      */
384:     protected function getPropertiesFromTable($model)
385:     {
386:         $table = $model->getConnection()->getTablePrefix() . $model->getTable();
387:         $schema = $model->getConnection()->getDoctrineSchemaManager();
388:         $databasePlatform = $schema->getDatabasePlatform();
389:         $databasePlatform->registerDoctrineTypeMapping('enum', 'string');
390: 
391:         $platformName = $databasePlatform->getName();
392:         $customTypes = $this->laravel['config']->get("ide-helper.custom_db_types.{$platformName}", []);
393:         foreach ($customTypes as $yourTypeName => $doctrineTypeName) {
394:             $databasePlatform->registerDoctrineTypeMapping($yourTypeName, $doctrineTypeName);
395:         }
396: 
397:         $database = null;
398:         if (strpos($table, '.')) {
399:             list($database, $table) = explode('.', $table);
400:         }
401: 
402:         $columns = $schema->listTableColumns($table, $database);
403: 
404:         if (!$columns) {
405:             return;
406:         }
407: 
408:         foreach ($columns as $column) {
409:             $name = $column->getName();
410:             if (in_array($name, $model->getDates())) {
411:                 $type = $this->dateClass;
412:             } else {
413:                 $type = $column->getType()->getName();
414:                 switch ($type) {
415:                     case 'string':
416:                     case 'text':
417:                     case 'date':
418:                     case 'time':
419:                     case 'guid':
420:                     case 'datetimetz':
421:                     case 'datetime':
422:                     case 'decimal':
423:                         $type = 'string';
424:                         break;
425:                     case 'integer':
426:                     case 'bigint':
427:                     case 'smallint':
428:                         $type = 'integer';
429:                         break;
430:                     case 'boolean':
431:                         switch (config('database.default')) {
432:                             case 'sqlite':
433:                             case 'mysql':
434:                                 $type = 'integer';
435:                                 break;
436:                             default:
437:                                 $type = 'boolean';
438:                                 break;
439:                         }
440:                         break;
441:                     case 'float':
442:                         $type = 'float';
443:                         break;
444:                     default:
445:                         $type = 'mixed';
446:                         break;
447:                 }
448:             }
449: 
450:             $comment = $column->getComment();
451:             if (!$column->getNotnull()) {
452:                 $this->nullableColumns[$name] = true;
453:             }
454:             $this->setProperty(
455:                 $name,
456:                 $this->getTypeInModel($model, $type),
457:                 true,
458:                 true,
459:                 $comment,
460:                 !$column->getNotnull()
461:             );
462:             if ($this->write_model_magic_where) {
463:                 $this->setMethod(
464:                     Str::camel('where_' . $name),
465:                     $this->getClassNameInDestinationFile($model, \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder::class)
466:                     . '|'
467:                     . $this->getClassNameInDestinationFile($model, get_class($model)),
468:                     ['$value']
469:                 );
470:             }
471:         }
472:     }

474:     /**
475:      * @param \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model $model
476:      */
477:     protected function getPropertiesFromMethods($model)
478:     {
479:         $methods = get_class_methods($model);
480:         if ($methods) {
481:             sort($methods);
482:             foreach ($methods as $method) {
483:                 if (
484:                     Str::startsWith($method, 'get') && Str::endsWith(
485:                         $method,
486:                         'Attribute'
487:                     ) && $method !== 'getAttribute'
488:                 ) {
489:                     //Magic get<name>Attribute
490:                     $name = Str::snake(substr($method, 3, -9));
491:                     if (!empty($name)) {
492:                         $reflection = new \ReflectionMethod($model, $method);
493:                         $type = $this->getReturnType($reflection);
494:                         $type = $this->getTypeInModel($model, $type);
495:                         $this->setProperty($name, $type, true, null);
496:                     }
497:                 } elseif (
498:                     Str::startsWith($method, 'set') && Str::endsWith(
499:                         $method,
500:                         'Attribute'
501:                     ) && $method !== 'setAttribute'
502:                 ) {
503:                     //Magic set<name>Attribute
504:                     $name = Str::snake(substr($method, 3, -9));
505:                     if (!empty($name)) {
506:                         $this->setProperty($name, null, null, true);
507:                     }
508:                 } elseif (Str::startsWith($method, 'scope') && $method !== 'scopeQuery') {
509:                     //Magic set<name>Attribute
510:                     $name = Str::camel(substr($method, 5));
511:                     if (!empty($name)) {
512:                         $reflection = new \ReflectionMethod($model, $method);
513:                         $args = $this->getParameters($reflection);
514:                         //Remove the first ($query) argument
515:                         array_shift($args);
516:                         $builder = $this->getClassNameInDestinationFile(
517:                             $reflection->getDeclaringClass(),
518:                             \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder::class
519:                         );
520:                         $modelName = $this->getClassNameInDestinationFile(
521:                             $reflection->getDeclaringClass(),
522:                             $reflection->getDeclaringClass()->getName()
523:                         );
524:                         $this->setMethod($name, $builder . '|' . $modelName, $args);
525:                     }
526:                 } elseif (in_array($method, ['query', 'newQuery', 'newModelQuery'])) {
527:                     $builder = $this->getClassNameInDestinationFile($model, get_class($model->newModelQuery()));
528: 
529:                     $this->setMethod(
530:                         $method,
531:                         $builder . '|' . $this->getClassNameInDestinationFile($model, get_class($model))
532:                     );
533:                 } elseif (
534:                     !method_exists('Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model', $method)
535:                     && !Str::startsWith($method, 'get')
536:                 ) {
537:                     //Use reflection to inspect the code, based on Illuminate/Support/SerializableClosure.php
538:                     $reflection = new \ReflectionMethod($model, $method);
539: 
540:                     if ($returnType = $reflection->getReturnType()) {
541:                         $type = $returnType instanceof \ReflectionNamedType
542:                             ? $returnType->getName()
543:                             : (string)$returnType;
544:                     } else {
545:                         // php 7.x type or fallback to docblock
546:                         $type = (string)$this->getReturnTypeFromDocBlock($reflection);
547:                     }
548: 
549:                     $file = new \SplFileObject($reflection->getFileName());
550:                     $file->seek($reflection->getStartLine() - 1);
551: 
552:                     $code = '';
553:                     while ($file->key() < $reflection->getEndLine()) {
554:                         $code .= $file->current();
555:                         $file->next();
556:                     }
557:                     $code = trim(preg_replace('/\s\s+/', '', $code));
558:                     $begin = strpos($code, 'function(');
559:                     $code = substr($code, $begin, strrpos($code, '}') - $begin + 1);
560: 
561:                     foreach (
562:                         [
563:                                'hasMany' => '\Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasMany',
564:                                'hasManyThrough' => '\Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasManyThrough',
565:                                'hasOneThrough' => '\Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasOneThrough',
566:                                'belongsToMany' => '\Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsToMany',
567:                                'hasOne' => '\Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasOne',
568:                                'belongsTo' => '\Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo',
569:                                'morphOne' => '\Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\MorphOne',
570:                                'morphTo' => '\Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\MorphTo',
571:                                'morphMany' => '\Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\MorphMany',
572:                                'morphToMany' => '\Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\MorphToMany',
573:                                'morphedByMany' => '\Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\MorphToMany',
574:                              ] as $relation => $impl
575:                     ) {
576:                         $search = '$this->' . $relation . '(';
577:                         if (stripos($code, $search) || ltrim($impl, '\\') === ltrim((string)$type, '\\')) {
578:                             //Resolve the relation's model to a Relation object.
579:                             $methodReflection = new \ReflectionMethod($model, $method);
580:                             if ($methodReflection->getNumberOfParameters()) {
581:                                 continue;
582:                             }
583: 
584:                             // Adding constraints requires reading model properties which
585:                             // can cause errors. Since we don't need constraints we can
586:                             // disable them when we fetch the relation to avoid errors.
587:                             $relationObj = Relation::noConstraints(function () use ($model, $method) {
588:                                 try {
589:                                     return $model->$method();
590:                                 } catch (\Throwable $e) {
591:                                     return null;
592:                                 }
593:                             });
594: 
595:                             if ($relationObj instanceof Relation) {
596:                                 $relatedModel = $this->getClassNameInDestinationFile(
597:                                     $model,
598:                                     get_class($relationObj->getRelated())
599:                                 );
600: 
601:                                 $relations = [
602:                                     'hasManyThrough',
603:                                     'belongsToMany',
604:                                     'hasMany',
605:                                     'morphMany',
606:                                     'morphToMany',
607:                                     'morphedByMany',
608:                                 ];
609:                                 if (strpos(get_class($relationObj), 'Many') !== false) {
610:                                     //Collection or array of models (because Collection is Arrayable)
611:                                     $relatedClass = '\\' . get_class($relationObj->getRelated());
612:                                     $collectionClass = $this->getCollectionClass($relatedClass);
613:                                     $collectionClassNameInModel = $this->getClassNameInDestinationFile(
614:                                         $model,
615:                                         $collectionClass
616:                                     );
617:                                     $this->setProperty(
618:                                         $method,
619:                                         $collectionClassNameInModel . '|' . $relatedModel . '[]',
620:                                         true,
621:                                         null
622:                                     );
623:                                     if ($this->write_model_relation_count_properties) {
624:                                         $this->setProperty(
625:                                             Str::snake($method) . '_count',
626:                                             'int|null',
627:                                             true,
628:                                             false
629:                                         );
630:                                     }
631:                                 } elseif ($relation === 'morphTo') {
632:                                     // Model isn't specified because relation is polymorphic
633:                                     $this->setProperty(
634:                                         $method,
635:                                         $this->getClassNameInDestinationFile($model, Model::class) . '|\Eloquent',
636:                                         true,
637:                                         null
638:                                     );
639:                                 } else {
640:                                     //Single model is returned
641:                                     $this->setProperty(
642:                                         $method,
643:                                         $relatedModel,
644:                                         true,
645:                                         null,
646:                                         '',
647:                                         $this->isRelationNullable($relation, $relationObj)
648:                                     );
649:                                 }
650:                             }
651:                         }
652:                     }
653:                 }
654:             }
655:         }
656:     }

658:     /**
659:      * Check if the relation is nullable
660:      *
661:      * @param string   $relation
662:      * @param Relation $relationObj
663:      *
664:      * @return bool
665:      */
666:     protected function isRelationNullable(string $relation, Relation $relationObj): bool
667:     {
668:         $reflectionObj = new ReflectionObject($relationObj);
669: 
670:         if (in_array($relation, ['hasOne', 'hasOneThrough', 'morphOne'], true)) {
671:             $defaultProp = $reflectionObj->getProperty('withDefault');
672:             $defaultProp->setAccessible(true);
673: 
674:             return !$defaultProp->getValue($relationObj);
675:         }
676: 
677:         if (!$reflectionObj->hasProperty('foreignKey')) {
678:             return false;
679:         }
680: 
681:         $fkProp = $reflectionObj->getProperty('foreignKey');
682:         $fkProp->setAccessible(true);
683: 
684:         return isset($this->nullableColumns[$fkProp->getValue($relationObj)]);
685:     }

702:             $this->properties[$name]['comment'] = (string) $comment;

706:             if ($nullable) {
707:                 $newType .= '|null';
708:             }
709:             $this->properties[$name]['type'] = $newType;
710:         }
711:         if ($read !== null) {
712:             $this->properties[$name]['read'] = $read;
713:         }
714:         if ($write !== null) {

730:     /**
731:      * @param string $class
732:      * @return string
733:      */
734:     protected function createPhpDocs($class)
735:     {
736: 
737:         $reflection = new ReflectionClass($class);
738:         $namespace = $reflection->getNamespaceName();
739:         $classname = $reflection->getShortName();
740:         $originalDoc = $reflection->getDocComment();
741:         $keyword = $this->getClassKeyword($reflection);
742:         $interfaceNames = array_diff_key(
743:             $reflection->getInterfaceNames(),
744:             $reflection->getParentClass()->getInterfaceNames()
745:         );
746: 
747:         if ($this->reset) {
748:             $phpdoc = new DocBlock('', new Context($namespace));
749:             if ($this->keep_text) {
750:                 $phpdoc->setText(
751:                     (new DocBlock($reflection, new Context($namespace)))->getText()
752:                 );
753:             }
754:         } else {
755:             $phpdoc = new DocBlock($reflection, new Context($namespace));
756:         }
757: 
758:         if (!$phpdoc->getText()) {
759:             $phpdoc->setText($class);
760:         }
761: 
762:         $properties = [];
763:         $methods = [];
764:         foreach ($phpdoc->getTags() as $tag) {
765:             $name = $tag->getName();
766:             if ($name == 'property' || $name == 'property-read' || $name == 'property-write') {
767:                 $properties[] = $tag->getVariableName();
768:             } elseif ($name == 'method') {
769:                 $methods[] = $tag->getMethodName();
770:             }
771:         }
772: 
773:         foreach ($this->properties as $name => $property) {
774:             $name = "\$$name";
775: 
776:             if ($this->hasCamelCaseModelProperties()) {
777:                 $name = Str::camel($name);
778:             }
779: 
780:             if (in_array($name, $properties)) {
781:                 continue;
782:             }
783:             if ($property['read'] && $property['write']) {
784:                 $attr = 'property';
785:             } elseif ($property['write']) {
786:                 $attr = 'property-write';
787:             } else {
788:                 $attr = 'property-read';
789:             }
790: 
791:             $tagLine = trim("@{$attr} {$property['type']} {$name} {$property['comment']}");
792:             $tag = Tag::createInstance($tagLine, $phpdoc);
793:             $phpdoc->appendTag($tag);
794:         }
795: 
796:         ksort($this->methods);
797: 
798:         foreach ($this->methods as $name => $method) {
799:             if (in_array($name, $methods)) {
800:                 continue;
801:             }
802:             $arguments = implode(', ', $method['arguments']);
803:             $tag = Tag::createInstance("@method static {$method['type']} {$name}({$arguments})", $phpdoc);
804:             $phpdoc->appendTag($tag);
805:         }
806: 
807:         if ($this->write && !$phpdoc->getTagsByName('mixin')) {
808:             $eloquentClassNameInModel = $this->getClassNameInDestinationFile($reflection, 'Eloquent');
809:             $phpdoc->appendTag(Tag::createInstance('@mixin ' . $eloquentClassNameInModel, $phpdoc));
810:         }
811:         if ($this->phpstorm_noinspections) {
812:             /**
813:              * Facades, Eloquent API
814:              * @see https://www.jetbrains.com/help/phpstorm/php-fully-qualified-name-usage.html
815:              */
816:             $phpdoc->appendTag(Tag::createInstance('@noinspection PhpFullyQualifiedNameUsageInspection', $phpdoc));
817:             /**
818:              * Relations, other models in the same namespace
819:              * @see https://www.jetbrains.com/help/phpstorm/php-unnecessary-fully-qualified-name.html
820:              */
821:             $phpdoc->appendTag(
822:                 Tag::createInstance('@noinspection PhpUnnecessaryFullyQualifiedNameInspection', $phpdoc)
823:             );
824:         }
825: 
826:         $serializer = new DocBlockSerializer();
827:         $serializer->getDocComment($phpdoc);
828:         $docComment = $serializer->getDocComment($phpdoc);
829:         $mixinClassName = null;
830:         $mixinDocComment = null;
831: 
832:         if ($this->write_mixin) {
833:             $phpdocMixin = new DocBlock($reflection, new Context($namespace));
834:             // remove all mixin tags prefixed with IdeHelper
835:             foreach ($phpdocMixin->getTagsByName('mixin') as $tag) {
836:                 if (Str::startsWith($tag->getContent(), 'IdeHelper')) {
837:                     $phpdocMixin->deleteTag($tag);
838:                 }
839:             }
840: 
841:             $mixinClassName = "IdeHelper{$classname}";
842:             $phpdocMixin->appendTag(Tag::createInstance("@mixin {$mixinClassName}", $phpdocMixin));
843:             $mixinDocComment = $serializer->getDocComment($phpdocMixin);
844:             // remove blank lines if there's no text
845:             if (!$phpdocMixin->getText()) {
846:                 $mixinDocComment = preg_replace("/\s\*\s*\n/", '', $mixinDocComment);
847:             }
848: 
849:             foreach ($phpdoc->getTagsByName('mixin') as $tag) {
850:                 if (Str::startsWith($tag->getContent(), 'IdeHelper')) {
851:                     $phpdoc->deleteTag($tag);
852:                 }
853:             }
854:             $docComment = $serializer->getDocComment($phpdoc);
855:         }
856: 
857:         if ($this->write) {
858:             $modelDocComment = $this->write_mixin ? $mixinDocComment : $docComment;
859:             $filename = $reflection->getFileName();
860:             $contents = $this->files->get($filename);
861:             if ($originalDoc) {
862:                 $contents = str_replace($originalDoc, $modelDocComment, $contents);
863:             } else {
864:                 $replace = "{$modelDocComment}\n";
865:                 $pos = strpos($contents, "final class {$classname}") ?: strpos($contents, "class {$classname}");
866:                 if ($pos !== false) {
867:                     $contents = substr_replace($contents, $replace, $pos, 0);
868:                 }
869:             }
870:             if ($this->files->put($filename, $contents)) {
871:                 $this->info('Written new phpDocBlock to ' . $filename);
872:             }
873:         }
874: 
875:         $classname = $this->write_mixin ? $mixinClassName : $classname;
876:         $output = "namespace {$namespace}{\n{$docComment}\n\t{$keyword}class {$classname} extends \Eloquent ";
877: 
878:         if ($interfaceNames) {
879:             $interfaces = implode(', \\', $interfaceNames);
880:             $output .= "implements \\{$interfaces} ";
881:         }
882: 
883:         return $output . "{}\n}\n\n";
884:     }

886:     /**
887:      * Get the parameters and format them correctly
888:      *
889:      * @param $method
890:      * @return array
891:      */
892:     public function getParameters($method)
893:     {

260:                 }
261:             }
262:         }
263: 
264:         if (!$hasDoctrine) {
265:             $this->error(
266:                 'Warning: `"doctrine/dbal": "~2.3"` is required to load database information. ' .
267:                 'Please require that in your composer.json and run `composer update`.'
268:             );
269:         }
270: 
271:         return $output;
272:     }

305:     /**
306:      * cast the properties's type from $casts.
307:      *
308:      * @param \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model $model
309:      */
310:     protected function castPropertiesType($model)
311:     {
312:         $casts = $model->getCasts();
313:         foreach ($casts as $name => $type) {
314:             switch ($type) {
315:                 case 'boolean':
316:                 case 'bool':
317:                     $realType = 'boolean';
318:                     break;
319:                 case 'string':
320:                     $realType = 'string';
321:                     break;
322:                 case 'array':
323:                 case 'json':
324:                     $realType = 'array';
325:                     break;
326:                 case 'object':
327:                     $realType = 'object';
328:                     break;
329:                 case 'int':
330:                 case 'integer':
331:                 case 'timestamp':
332:                     $realType = 'integer';
333:                     break;
334:                 case 'real':
335:                 case 'double':
336:                 case 'float':
337:                     $realType = 'float';
338:                     break;
339:                 case 'date':
340:                 case 'datetime':
341:                     $realType = $this->dateClass;
342:                     break;
343:                 case 'collection':
344:                     $realType = '\Illuminate\Support\Collection';
345:                     break;
346:                 default:
347:                     $realType = class_exists($type) ? ('\\' . $type) : 'mixed';
348:                     break;
349:             }
350: 
351:             if (!isset($this->properties[$name])) {
352:                 continue;
353:             }
354: 
355:             $realType = $this->checkForCustomLaravelCasts($realType);
356:             $realType = $this->getTypeOverride($realType);
357:             $this->properties[$name]['type'] = $this->getTypeInModel($model, $realType);
358: 
359:             if (isset($this->nullableColumns[$name])) {
360:                 $this->properties[$name]['type'] .= '|null';
361:             }
362:         }
363:     }
