378:     /**
379:      * Load the properties from the database table.
380:      *
381:      * @param \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model $model
382:      */
383:     protected function getPropertiesFromTable($model)
384:     {
385:         $table = $model->getConnection()->getTablePrefix() . $model->getTable();
386:         $schema = $model->getConnection()->getDoctrineSchemaManager();
387:         $databasePlatform = $schema->getDatabasePlatform();
388:         $databasePlatform->registerDoctrineTypeMapping('enum', 'string');
389: 
390:         $platformName = $databasePlatform->getName();
391:         $customTypes = $this->laravel['config']->get("ide-helper.custom_db_types.{$platformName}", []);
392:         foreach ($customTypes as $yourTypeName => $doctrineTypeName) {
393:             $databasePlatform->registerDoctrineTypeMapping($yourTypeName, $doctrineTypeName);
394:         }
395: 
396:         $database = null;
397:         if (strpos($table, '.')) {
398:             list($database, $table) = explode('.', $table);
399:         }
400: 
401:         $columns = $schema->listTableColumns($table, $database);
402: 
403:         if (!$columns) {
404:             return;
405:         }
406: 
407:         foreach ($columns as $column) {
408:             $name = $column->getName();
409:             if (in_array($name, $model->getDates())) {
410:                 $type = $this->dateClass;
411:             } else {
412:                 $type = $column->getType()->getName();
413:                 switch ($type) {
414:                     case 'string':
415:                     case 'text':
416:                     case 'date':
417:                     case 'time':
418:                     case 'guid':
419:                     case 'datetimetz':
420:                     case 'datetime':
421:                     case 'decimal':
422:                         $type = 'string';
423:                         break;
424:                     case 'integer':
425:                     case 'bigint':
426:                     case 'smallint':
427:                         $type = 'integer';
428:                         break;
429:                     case 'boolean':
430:                         switch (config('database.default')) {
431:                             case 'sqlite':
432:                             case 'mysql':
433:                                 $type = 'integer';
434:                                 break;
435:                             default:
436:                                 $type = 'boolean';
437:                                 break;
438:                         }
439:                         break;
440:                     case 'float':
441:                         $type = 'float';
442:                         break;
443:                     default:
444:                         $type = 'mixed';
445:                         break;
446:                 }
447:             }
448: 
449:             $comment = $column->getComment();
450:             if (!$column->getNotnull()) {
451:                 $this->nullableColumns[$name] = true;
452:             }
453:             $this->setProperty(
454:                 $name,
455:                 $this->getTypeInModel($model, $type),
456:                 true,
457:                 true,
458:                 $comment,
459:                 !$column->getNotnull()
460:             );
461:             if ($this->write_model_magic_where) {
462:                 $this->setMethod(
463:                     Str::camel('where_' . $name),
464:                     $this->getClassNameInDestinationFile($model, \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder::class)
465:                     . '|'
466:                     . $this->getClassNameInDestinationFile($model, get_class($model)),
467:                     ['$value']
468:                 );
469:             }
470:         }
471:     }

473:     /**
474:      * @param \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model $model
475:      */
476:     protected function getPropertiesFromMethods($model)
477:     {
478:         $methods = get_class_methods($model);
479:         if ($methods) {
480:             sort($methods);
481:             foreach ($methods as $method) {
482:                 if (
483:                     Str::startsWith($method, 'get') && Str::endsWith(
484:                         $method,
485:                         'Attribute'
486:                     ) && $method !== 'getAttribute'
487:                 ) {
488:                     //Magic get<name>Attribute
489:                     $name = Str::snake(substr($method, 3, -9));
490:                     if (!empty($name)) {
491:                         $reflection = new \ReflectionMethod($model, $method);
492:                         $type = $this->getReturnType($reflection);
493:                         $type = $this->getTypeInModel($model, $type);
494:                         $this->setProperty($name, $type, true, null);
495:                     }
496:                 } elseif (
497:                     Str::startsWith($method, 'set') && Str::endsWith(
498:                         $method,
499:                         'Attribute'
500:                     ) && $method !== 'setAttribute'
501:                 ) {
502:                     //Magic set<name>Attribute
503:                     $name = Str::snake(substr($method, 3, -9));
504:                     if (!empty($name)) {
505:                         $this->setProperty($name, null, null, true);
506:                     }
507:                 } elseif (Str::startsWith($method, 'scope') && $method !== 'scopeQuery') {
508:                     //Magic set<name>Attribute
509:                     $name = Str::camel(substr($method, 5));
510:                     if (!empty($name)) {
511:                         $reflection = new \ReflectionMethod($model, $method);
512:                         $args = $this->getParameters($reflection);
513:                         //Remove the first ($query) argument
514:                         array_shift($args);
515:                         $builder = $this->getClassNameInDestinationFile(
516:                             $reflection->getDeclaringClass(),
517:                             \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder::class
518:                         );
519:                         $modelName = $this->getClassNameInDestinationFile(
520:                             $reflection->getDeclaringClass(),
521:                             $reflection->getDeclaringClass()->getName()
522:                         );
523:                         $this->setMethod($name, $builder . '|' . $modelName, $args);
524:                     }
525:                 } elseif (in_array($method, ['query', 'newQuery', 'newModelQuery'])) {
526:                     $builder = $this->getClassNameInDestinationFile($model, get_class($model->newModelQuery()));
527: 
528:                     $this->setMethod(
529:                         $method,
530:                         $builder . '|' . $this->getClassNameInDestinationFile($model, get_class($model))
531:                     );
532:                 } elseif (
533:                     !method_exists('Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model', $method)
534:                     && !Str::startsWith($method, 'get')
535:                 ) {
536:                     //Use reflection to inspect the code, based on Illuminate/Support/SerializableClosure.php
537:                     $reflection = new \ReflectionMethod($model, $method);
538: 
539:                     if ($returnType = $reflection->getReturnType()) {
540:                         $type = $returnType instanceof \ReflectionNamedType
541:                             ? $returnType->getName()
542:                             : (string)$returnType;
543:                     } else {
544:                         // php 7.x type or fallback to docblock
545:                         $type = (string)$this->getReturnTypeFromDocBlock($reflection);
546:                     }
547: 
548:                     $file = new \SplFileObject($reflection->getFileName());
549:                     $file->seek($reflection->getStartLine() - 1);
550: 
551:                     $code = '';
552:                     while ($file->key() < $reflection->getEndLine()) {
553:                         $code .= $file->current();
554:                         $file->next();
555:                     }
556:                     $code = trim(preg_replace('/\s\s+/', '', $code));
557:                     $begin = strpos($code, 'function(');
558:                     $code = substr($code, $begin, strrpos($code, '}') - $begin + 1);
559: 
560:                     foreach (
561:                         [
562:                                'hasMany' => '\Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasMany',
563:                                'hasManyThrough' => '\Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasManyThrough',
564:                                'hasOneThrough' => '\Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasOneThrough',
565:                                'belongsToMany' => '\Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsToMany',
566:                                'hasOne' => '\Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasOne',
567:                                'belongsTo' => '\Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo',
568:                                'morphOne' => '\Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\MorphOne',
569:                                'morphTo' => '\Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\MorphTo',
570:                                'morphMany' => '\Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\MorphMany',
571:                                'morphToMany' => '\Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\MorphToMany',
572:                                'morphedByMany' => '\Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\MorphToMany',
573:                              ] as $relation => $impl
574:                     ) {
575:                         $search = '$this->' . $relation . '(';
576:                         if (stripos($code, $search) || ltrim($impl, '\\') === ltrim((string)$type, '\\')) {
577:                             //Resolve the relation's model to a Relation object.
578:                             $methodReflection = new \ReflectionMethod($model, $method);
579:                             if ($methodReflection->getNumberOfParameters()) {
580:                                 continue;
581:                             }
582: 
583:                             // Adding constraints requires reading model properties which
584:                             // can cause errors. Since we don't need constraints we can
585:                             // disable them when we fetch the relation to avoid errors.
586:                             $relationObj = Relation::noConstraints(function () use ($model, $method) {
587:                                 try {
588:                                     return $model->$method();
589:                                 } catch (\Throwable $e) {
590:                                     return null;
591:                                 }
592:                             });
593: 
594:                             if ($relationObj instanceof $impl) {
595:                                 $relatedModel = $this->getClassNameInDestinationFile(
596:                                     $model,
597:                                     get_class($relationObj->getRelated())
598:                                 );
599: 
600:                                 $relations = [
601:                                     'hasManyThrough',
602:                                     'belongsToMany',
603:                                     'hasMany',
604:                                     'morphMany',
605:                                     'morphToMany',
606:                                     'morphedByMany',
607:                                 ];
608:                                 if (strpos(get_class($relationObj), 'Many') !== false) {
609:                                     //Collection or array of models (because Collection is Arrayable)
610:                                     $relatedClass = '\\' . get_class($relationObj->getRelated());
611:                                     $collectionClass = $this->getCollectionClass($relatedClass);
612:                                     $collectionClassNameInModel = $this->getClassNameInDestinationFile(
613:                                         $model,
614:                                         $collectionClass
615:                                     );
616:                                     $this->setProperty(
617:                                         $method,
618:                                         $collectionClassNameInModel . '|' . $relatedModel . '[]',
619:                                         true,
620:                                         null
621:                                     );
622:                                     if ($this->write_model_relation_count_properties) {
623:                                         $this->setProperty(
624:                                             Str::snake($method) . '_count',
625:                                             'int|null',
626:                                             true,
627:                                             false
628:                                         );
629:                                     }
630:                                 } elseif ($relation === 'morphTo') {
631:                                     // Model isn't specified because relation is polymorphic
632:                                     $this->setProperty(
633:                                         $method,
634:                                         $relatedModel . '|\Eloquent',
635:                                         true,
636:                                         null
637:                                     );
638:                                 } else {
639:                                     //Single model is returned
640:                                     $this->setProperty(
641:                                         $method,
642:                                         $relatedModel,
643:                                         true,
644:                                         null,
645:                                         '',
646:                                         $this->isRelationNullable($relation, $relationObj)
647:                                     );
648:                                 }
649:                             }
650:                         }
651:                     }
652:                 }
653:             }
654:         }
655:     }

657:     /**
658:      * Check if the relation is nullable
659:      *
660:      * @param string   $relation
661:      * @param Relation $relationObj
662:      *
663:      * @return bool
664:      */
665:     protected function isRelationNullable(string $relation, Relation $relationObj): bool
666:     {
667:         $reflectionObj = new ReflectionObject($relationObj);
668: 
669:         if (in_array($relation, ['hasOne', 'hasOneThrough', 'morphOne'], true)) {
670:             $defaultProp = $reflectionObj->getProperty('withDefault');
671:             $defaultProp->setAccessible(true);
672: 
673:             return !$defaultProp->getValue($relationObj);
674:         }
675: 
676:         if (!$reflectionObj->hasProperty('foreignKey')) {
677:             return false;
678:         }
679: 
680:         $fkProp = $reflectionObj->getProperty('foreignKey');
681:         $fkProp->setAccessible(true);
682: 
683:         return isset($this->nullableColumns[$fkProp->getValue($relationObj)]);
684:     }

711:             $this->properties[$name]['read'] = $read;
712:         }

729:     /**
730:      * @param string $class
731:      * @return string
732:      */
733:     protected function createPhpDocs($class)
734:     {
735: 
736:         $reflection = new ReflectionClass($class);
737:         $namespace = $reflection->getNamespaceName();
738:         $classname = $reflection->getShortName();
739:         $originalDoc = $reflection->getDocComment();
740:         $keyword = $this->getClassKeyword($reflection);
741:         $interfaceNames = array_diff_key(
742:             $reflection->getInterfaceNames(),
743:             $reflection->getParentClass()->getInterfaceNames()
744:         );
745: 
746:         if ($this->reset) {
747:             $phpdoc = new DocBlock('', new Context($namespace));
748:             if ($this->keep_text) {
749:                 $phpdoc->setText(
750:                     (new DocBlock($reflection, new Context($namespace)))->getText()
751:                 );
752:             }
753:         } else {
754:             $phpdoc = new DocBlock($reflection, new Context($namespace));
755:         }
756: 
757:         if (!$phpdoc->getText()) {
758:             $phpdoc->setText($class);
759:         }
760: 
761:         $properties = [];
762:         $methods = [];
763:         foreach ($phpdoc->getTags() as $tag) {
764:             $name = $tag->getName();
765:             if ($name == 'property' || $name == 'property-read' || $name == 'property-write') {
766:                 $properties[] = $tag->getVariableName();
767:             } elseif ($name == 'method') {
768:                 $methods[] = $tag->getMethodName();
769:             }
770:         }
771: 
772:         foreach ($this->properties as $name => $property) {
773:             $name = "\$$name";
774: 
775:             if ($this->hasCamelCaseModelProperties()) {
776:                 $name = Str::camel($name);
777:             }
778: 
779:             if (in_array($name, $properties)) {
780:                 continue;
781:             }
782:             if ($property['read'] && $property['write']) {
783:                 $attr = 'property';
784:             } elseif ($property['write']) {
785:                 $attr = 'property-write';
786:             } else {
787:                 $attr = 'property-read';
788:             }
789: 
790:             $tagLine = trim("@{$attr} {$property['type']} {$name} {$property['comment']}");
791:             $tag = Tag::createInstance($tagLine, $phpdoc);
792:             $phpdoc->appendTag($tag);
793:         }
794: 
795:         ksort($this->methods);
796: 
797:         foreach ($this->methods as $name => $method) {
798:             if (in_array($name, $methods)) {
799:                 continue;
800:             }
801:             $arguments = implode(', ', $method['arguments']);
802:             $tag = Tag::createInstance("@method static {$method['type']} {$name}({$arguments})", $phpdoc);
803:             $phpdoc->appendTag($tag);
804:         }
805: 
806:         if ($this->write && !$phpdoc->getTagsByName('mixin')) {
807:             $eloquentClassNameInModel = $this->getClassNameInDestinationFile($reflection, 'Eloquent');
808:             $phpdoc->appendTag(Tag::createInstance('@mixin ' . $eloquentClassNameInModel, $phpdoc));
809:         }
810:         if ($this->phpstorm_noinspections) {
811:             /**
812:              * Facades, Eloquent API
813:              * @see https://www.jetbrains.com/help/phpstorm/php-fully-qualified-name-usage.html
814:              */
815:             $phpdoc->appendTag(Tag::createInstance('@noinspection PhpFullyQualifiedNameUsageInspection', $phpdoc));
816:             /**
817:              * Relations, other models in the same namespace
818:              * @see https://www.jetbrains.com/help/phpstorm/php-unnecessary-fully-qualified-name.html
819:              */
820:             $phpdoc->appendTag(
821:                 Tag::createInstance('@noinspection PhpUnnecessaryFullyQualifiedNameInspection', $phpdoc)
822:             );
823:         }
824: 
825:         $serializer = new DocBlockSerializer();
826:         $serializer->getDocComment($phpdoc);
827:         $docComment = $serializer->getDocComment($phpdoc);
828:         $mixinClassName = null;
829:         $mixinDocComment = null;
830: 
831:         if ($this->write_mixin) {
832:             $phpdocMixin = new DocBlock($reflection, new Context($namespace));
833:             // remove all mixin tags prefixed with IdeHelper
834:             foreach ($phpdocMixin->getTagsByName('mixin') as $tag) {
835:                 if (Str::startsWith($tag->getContent(), 'IdeHelper')) {
836:                     $phpdocMixin->deleteTag($tag);
837:                 }
838:             }
839: 
840:             $mixinClassName = "IdeHelper{$classname}";
841:             $phpdocMixin->appendTag(Tag::createInstance("@mixin {$mixinClassName}", $phpdocMixin));
842:             $mixinDocComment = $serializer->getDocComment($phpdocMixin);
843:             // remove blank lines if there's no text
844:             if (!$phpdocMixin->getText()) {
845:                 $mixinDocComment = preg_replace("/\s\*\s*\n/", '', $mixinDocComment);
846:             }
847: 
848:             foreach ($phpdoc->getTagsByName('mixin') as $tag) {
849:                 if (Str::startsWith($tag->getContent(), 'IdeHelper')) {
850:                     $phpdoc->deleteTag($tag);
851:                 }
852:             }
853:             $docComment = $serializer->getDocComment($phpdoc);
854:         }
855: 
856:         if ($this->write) {
857:             $modelDocComment = $this->write_mixin ? $mixinDocComment : $docComment;
858:             $filename = $reflection->getFileName();
859:             $contents = $this->files->get($filename);
860:             if ($originalDoc) {
861:                 $contents = str_replace($originalDoc, $modelDocComment, $contents);
862:             } else {
863:                 $replace = "{$modelDocComment}\n";
864:                 $pos = strpos($contents, "final class {$classname}") ?: strpos($contents, "class {$classname}");
865:                 if ($pos !== false) {
866:                     $contents = substr_replace($contents, $replace, $pos, 0);
867:                 }
868:             }
869:             if ($this->files->put($filename, $contents)) {
870:                 $this->info('Written new phpDocBlock to ' . $filename);
871:             }
872:         }
873: 
874:         $classname = $this->write_mixin ? $mixinClassName : $classname;
875:         $output = "namespace {$namespace}{\n{$docComment}\n\t{$keyword}class {$classname} extends \Eloquent ";
876: 
877:         if ($interfaceNames) {
878:             $interfaces = implode(', \\', $interfaceNames);
879:             $output .= "implements \\{$interfaces} ";
880:         }
881: 
882:         return $output . "{}\n}\n\n";
883:     }

885:     /**
886:      * Get the parameters and format them correctly
887:      *
888:      * @param $method
889:      * @return array
890:      */
891:     public function getParameters($method)
892:     {
893:         //Loop through the default values for parameters, and make the correct output string
894:         $paramsWithDefault = [];
895:         /** @var \ReflectionParameter $param */
896:         foreach ($method->getParameters() as $param) {
897:             $paramClass = $param->getClass();
898:             $paramStr = (!is_null($paramClass) ? '\\' . $paramClass->getName() . ' ' : '') . '$' . $param->getName();
899:             if ($param->isOptional() && $param->isDefaultValueAvailable()) {

When the ModelsCommand analyzes a model's methods to generate PHPDoc annotations, it invokes each relation method to inspect the returned relation object. For BelongsTo relations where the property name matches the foreign key column name, invoking the relation method directly can trigger an undefined property error in Laravel (related to constraint loading).

    The goal is to prevent these undefined property errors when analyzing BelongsTo relations. Since the relation constraints are not needed for analysis purposes, fetch relation objects with constraints disabled to avoid triggering the underlying issue.

    Specifically, when calling `$model->$method()` to obtain the relation object, wrap the call in a `Relation::noConstraints()` closure. This prevents Laravel from attempting to access model properties during constraint setup, avoiding the undefined property error.

    Additionally, add a test case that reproduces the scenario where a BelongsTo relation method name matches a column name, ensuring the command completes successfully without errors and generates the correct PHPDoc.
